FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about working with us.

Yes — to begin any project, we require a minimum 20% advance payment. The remaining balance is payable at agreed project milestones or on completion. The finished website is handed over only after full payment is received.

A standard brochure website typically takes around 1 week. Larger e-commerce or complex custom projects may take 4–6 weeks. Need it urgently? Ask about our VIP Custom Pack — we can deliver within 48 hours for a priority fee.

Yes. We offer monthly and yearly maintenance packages that include hosting, security updates, and content changes. You never have to worry about your site going down, getting hacked, or falling behind.

Local SEO is a long-term investment. You may see initial movement in the first 1–2 months, but substantial, stable results typically emerge around months 3–6. We provide monthly reports throughout so you can see exactly how your rankings are progressing.

Absolutely. We specialise in redesigns that modernise your online presence without sacrificing your existing SEO value or content structure. You get a fresh, modern look while keeping what's already working for you.

We build on WordPress, Shopify, and WooCommerce depending on your needs. We also build fully custom HTML/CSS/JS sites for maximum performance. We'll recommend the best platform for your specific goals during our initial consultation.

All web design packages include 1 month of free email support after launch. After that, we offer affordable monthly maintenance plans. You can also reach us any time on WhatsApp for quick questions and updates.
